questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{这是泊松分布，所以}E(X)=\lambda,\ D(X)=\lambda.\\&\text{由矩估计法可知，样本均值}\overline{X}=\text{总体均值}\lambda\text{的矩估计量，本二阶中心矩}\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}(X_{i}-\overline{X})^{2}=\text{总体方差}\lambda\text{的矩估计量.}\\&\text{泊松分布的似然函数为}\\&\qquad L(\lambda)=\prod_{i=1}^{n}P\{X=x_{i}\}=\frac{e^{-n\lambda}\lambda^{\sum_{i=1}^{n}x_{i}}}{x_{1}!\cdots x_{n}!}.\\&\text{令}\frac{d\ln L(\lambda)}{d\lambda}=0,\text{即}-n+\frac{1}{\lambda}\sum_{i=1}^{n}x_{i}=0.\\&\text{所以}\lambda\text{的极大似然估计量为}\hat{\lambda}=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}X_{i}=\overline{X}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由单正态总体均值的区间估计可以阐明.}\\&\text{在方差未知的情况下，对于单正态总体均值的区间估计，}\\&\text{构造函数}T=\frac{\overline{X}-\mu}{S\sqrt{n}}\sim t(n-1).\\&\text{在置信度}1-\alpha\text{下，均值}\mu\text{的置信区间为}\\&\quad\left(\overline{X}-t_{\alpha2}(n-1)\frac{S}{\sqrt{n}},\ \overline{X}+t_{\alpha2}(n-1)\frac{S}{\sqrt{n}}\right).\\&\text{由此可以看出，要求均值}\mu\text{的区间估计，先构造与样本和均值}\mu\text{有关的统计量，再由此统计量来作区间估计.}\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由于没有给出总体分布，故无法求}\mu\text{的极大似然估计。}\\&E(\overline{X})=D(\overline{X})+E^2(\overline{X})=\frac{1}{n}+\mu^2,\ \text{所以}\overline{X}\text{不是}\mu^2\text{的无偏估计。}\\&\text{由切比雪夫不等式有}\\&P\{\overline{X}-\mu|<\varepsilon\}\geq 1-\frac{1}{\varepsilon^2}D(\overline{X})=1-\frac{1}{n\varepsilon^2}D(X)=1-\frac{1}{n\varepsilon^2}.\\&\text{如果是正态总体，则}\sqrt{n(\overline{X}-\mu)}=\left(\frac{n\overline{X}-n\mu}{\sqrt{n}}\right)\sim N(0,1),\ n(\overline{X}-\mu)^2\sim\chi^2(1).\\&\text{或由中心极限定理，当}\sigma\text{很大时，}n(\overline{X}-\mu)^2=\left(\frac{n\overline{X}-n\mu}{\sqrt{n}}\right)^2\sim\chi^2(1).\end{aligned}
